text:
maria: Release cut blocked — notary signing timed out for build 2026.03.21-rc2, plus CI test collector spiking failures. Hold the promo?
tom: seeing repeated 504s from notary at 10:12 UTC. logs show `sign()` retry loop hitting overall timeout. tagging infra.
maria: @tom can you paste the notary response body? :eyes:
tom: body: `{"error":"gateway_timeout","operation":"sign","trace":"..."}`. Running a retry now: `deploybot retry-sign build-20260321-rc2`
ci-bot: CI: test-collector parallel workers scaled to 120 -> 480 over the last 6m, flakiness up 6% (baseline 0.7%). Failing suites: integration/auth, e2e/payments.
jen: I just repro locally a race in integration/auth with parallel=8. Looks like db fixture teardown overlaps with new fixture creation.
sre-kishore: Notary cluster autoscaled but hit connection pool limits. I'll increase pool and rotate the signer pod. ETA 8 mins.
maria: Decision call: do we wait for notary fix + rerun full canary? Or pin to last-good image and promote? We prefer not to promote if canary failing.
jen: If we pin we skip canary validation — risky for this release. I vote hold and rerun once notary is stable; we can run targeted re-runs for failing suites first.
tom: deploy-bot blocked the promo: `deploy-bot: promo halted due to artifact-signature-mismatch`. We can initiate manual promote with `--force-signature-accept` but requires eng-lead signoff.
maria: @jen @sre-kishore +1 on hold. I'll file a rollback/hotfix ticket and schedule rerun. Also let's capture the failing test logs into a prompt set.
maria: Created ticket: https://tickets/redwood/INC-9248 — hold release; rerun tests after signers rotate. @tom can you attach the notary logs to the ticket?
tom: attached logs and the curl trace. Also kicked off a targeted rerun for integration/auth and e2e/payments: buildkite build 98765.
ci-bot: Build 98765 started: integration/auth rerun (2 jobs), e2e/payments rerun (3 jobs).
sre-kishore: Signer pod restarted, connection pool bumped to 200. Observability shows notary 200 responses resumed at 10:28 UTC.
ci-bot: Build 98765: integration/auth -> 1/2 passed, 1 failed (same flaky). e2e/payments -> all 3 passed.
jen: Integration/auth still flaky on job 2 — stack shows `fixture_teardown` overlapping query to `test_db`. I'll add a 200ms delay to teardown in the fixture and run a local loop.
maria: For transparency: holding release until integration/auth fixed or we get a deterministic rollback plan. No promo before noon PT.
tom: If fix looks non-trivial, suggestion: pin to last-known-good image sha: sha256:abc123... and create a beta release with current build for investigation.
maria: :thumbsup: go with hold. I'll update release notes and notify PMs.
deploy-bot: Promotion status: held. Manual promote requires `deploybot promote --force --approver=maria`.
maria: I'll not force. Closing thread; will post updates in #eng-releases when reruns green or we pin. Thanks all.
